description: HIGH PRIORITY: Enhance rate limiting coverage, improve XSS sanitization, add account lockout, implement proper logout with token invalidation, add refresh token rotation, secure error handling, add redirect URL validation, and comprehensive security headers. This feature addresses gaps in rate limiting (verify-email endpoint not covered), upgrades XSS prevention to use industry-standard libraries, and adds defense-in-depth mechanisms.
steps: 1. RATE LIMITING - backend/src/middleware/rate-limit.middleware.ts: Add emailVerificationLimiter already exists (line 94) but not applied. Verify usage.

2. RATE LIMITING - backend/src/routes/auth.routes.ts: Apply emailVerificationLimiter to /verify-email route (currently line 25, no rate limit). Also apply to /resend-verification (line 28, has authLimiter but should use emailVerificationLimiter for 10/hr not 5/15min).
3. XSS SANITIZATION - Install sanitization libraries: `npm install dompurify jsdom @types/dompurify @types/jsdom` in backend/.

4. XSS SANITIZATION - backend/src/middleware/security.middleware.ts: Replace sanitizeString() function (line 61) with DOMPurify-based sanitization. Import: `import createDOMPurify from 'dompurify'; import { JSDOM } from 'jsdom'; const window = new JSDOM('').window; const DOMPurify = createDOMPurify(window);`
5. XSS SANITIZATION - Update sanitizeString() to: `return DOMPurify.sanitize(str, { ALLOWED_TAGS: [], ALLOWED_ATTR: [] });` for aggressive sanitization (strips all HTML).

6. XSS SANITIZATION - For fields that allow rich text (product descriptions, reviews), create sanitizeRichText() function: `DOMPurify.sanitize(str, { ALLOWED_TAGS: ['b', 'i', 'em', 'strong', 'p', 'br'], ALLOWED_ATTR: [] });`

7. ACCOUNT LOCKOUT - backend/src/services/auth.service.ts: Add failedLoginAttempts tracking. In login() method (after line 98 password verification failure), increment counter in Redis or DB. If >= 5 attempts in 15min, throw AccountLockedError. Reset counter on successful login.
8. ACCOUNT LOCKOUT - Add Redis-based attempt tracking if Redis available, else use in-memory Map with TTL. Key: `failed_login:${email}`, value: attempt count, TTL: 15min.

9. LOGOUT WITH INVALIDATION - Create token blacklist in Redis. backend/src/services/auth.service.ts: Add logout(userId, accessToken) method that stores token in Redis set `blacklisted_tokens:${userId}` with TTL equal to token expiry.
10. LOGOUT WITH INVALIDATION - backend/src/middleware/auth.middleware.ts: In authenticate(), after JWT verification, check if token in blacklist. If yes, throw UnauthorizedError.
11. LOGOUT WITH INVALIDATION - backend/src/controllers/auth.controller.ts: Update logout() method (line 135) to call authService.logout(req.user.id, token).

12. REFRESH TOKEN ROTATION - backend/src/services/auth.service.ts: In refreshToken() method (after line 230), invalidate the old refresh token (add to blacklist) before issuing new one. Generate new refresh token each time.
13. SECURE ERROR HANDLING - backend/src/middleware/error.middleware.ts: Verify errorHandler() does NOT leak stack traces in production. Check if config.isProduction is used to hide details.

14. SECURE ERROR HANDLING - If not already done, ensure error responses in production only return: { success: false, error: { code: 'ERROR_CODE', message: 'Generic message' } }. No stack, no internal paths.

15. REDIRECT VALIDATION - Create validateRedirectUrl() utility in backend/src/utils/helpers.ts: Check redirect URLs against whitelist of allowed domains (config.frontendUrl). Prevent open redirect attacks.
16. REDIRECT VALIDATION - backend/src/controllers/auth.controller.ts and anywhere redirects occur: Validate redirect query params with validateRedirectUrl() before using.

17. SECURITY HEADERS - backend/src/app.ts: Verify helmet configuration (line 31) includes all recommended headers. Current config looks good but ensure HSTS is enabled in production (already at line 53).
18. SECURITY HEADERS - Add Permissions-Policy header via helmet: `permissionsPolicy: { features: { geolocation: ["'none'"], microphone: ["'none'"], camera: ["'none'"] } }`

19. PASSWORD RESET SECURITY - backend/src/services/auth.service.ts: In resetPassword() (around line 180), ensure token is marked as 'used' after successful reset to prevent reuse. Check passwordResetRepository.markAsUsed().
20. PASSWORD RESET SECURITY - Implement time-limited tokens: Verify expiresAt is checked. Add expiry to 1 hour for password reset tokens.
21. EMAIL VERIFICATION EXPIRY - Verify email verification tokens expire. Check emailVerificationRepository and CONSTANTS.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_EXPIRY_HOURS (should be 24-48 hours).
22. REQUEST ID TRACKING - Add request ID middleware for audit trails: Install `npm install express-request-id`, add to app.ts before routes, include in logger context.
acceptance_criteria: Rate limiting applied to /verify-email (10/hr) and /resend-verification (10/hr) endpoints
XSS sanitization uses DOMPurify with appropriate configurations for different field types
Failed login attempts tracked; account locked after 5 failures in 15 minutes
Logout invalidates tokens by adding to Redis blacklist (or in-memory if Redis unavailable)
Refresh token rotation: old refresh token invalidated when new one issued
Production error responses contain no stack traces, internal paths, or sensitive details
Redirect URLs validated against whitelist before use
Permissions-Policy header added to helmet configuration
Password reset tokens marked as used after successful reset
Request ID added to all requests and included in logs
All existing auth flows work correctly with new security measures
verification: Run `npm run lint` in backend/ - no TypeScript errors
Run `npm install` in backend/ after package.json changes
Run backend tests: `npm run test:unit` if auth service has tests
Manual test: Attempt login with wrong password 5 times rapidly, verify 6th attempt returns account locked error
Manual test: Login successfully, logout, try to use same access token, verify it's rejected as blacklisted
Manual test: Use refresh token twice, verify second use is rejected (rotation)
Manual test: In production mode (NODE_ENV=production), trigger an error, verify response has no stack trace
Manual test: Check response headers for Permissions-Policy
Manual test: Request password reset, wait for email, use reset link, verify it works once then fails on second use
Grep check: `grep -r "emailVerificationLimiter" backend/src/routes/auth.routes.ts` shows it's applied to verify-email endpoint
Start dev server, hit /api/v1/auth/verify-email 12 times rapidly, verify 11th and 12th are rate limited
